_note: Balance numbers for radiation and health (role 06). Dose is in % of the career limit. Change numbers here, not in code.
illnessFromChapter_note: GAME.md: illness and medicine start in chapter 3.
timeCompression_note: Game dose = real ISS dose x 50. Picked so a player who keeps an astronaut outside half of every day reaches the yellow zone (50%) in about 4.8 days. Real dose builds up over months; we say so honestly in the game and in docs/NASA_DATA.md.

storm.warningHours_note: How many game hours before the storm the warning comes.
storm.shelterPowerNeeded_note: How many power blocks the shelter needs (Power.Shelter) to protect, by strength.
storm.perHour_note: Dose in % of limit per game hour during a storm, by strength 1/2/3: outside / in another module / in a powered shelter.

health.sickChance_note: Chance per hour for each healthy astronaut (about 9% a day).
health.sickToSevereHours_note: A sick astronaut without medicine becomes Severe after this many hours (unless the medic is on Heal and the medbay has power).
